say:4:1411431001:1.text: Thanks to the Magister, everything has finally calmed down.
say:4:1411431001:1.source_cn: 地面总算静下来了，多亏了主人的魔法！
say:4:1411431001:1.male: Thanks to the Magister, everything has finally calmed down.
say:4:1411431001:1.female: Thanks to the Magister, everything has finally calmed down.

say:5:1411431002:1.text: Kulu is not really good in a fight, but her bombs are really dangerous underground.
say:5:1411431002:1.source_cn: 库露露战斗不太行，但丢起炸弹来还真挺有威胁的，特别是在...

say:6:1411431003:1.text: It's not just fighting. She needs to work on her vocabulary. Even her familiar was correcting her. Chippy probably has better vocabulary... Well, maybe...
say:6:1411431003:1.source_cn: 不止是战斗不行吧，我感觉用词水平上，她还不如她那个使魔...

say:7:1411431004:1.text: She's like one of those kids who's always talking about death and gloomy things. They don't like to study, and all they think about is evil.
say:7:1411431004:1.source_cn: 就像是那种城镇里十三四岁的恶魔崇拜者一样，不好好念书，...

say:8:1411431005:1.text: Also, she's not very calculating. She's got a temper, yeah, but she's not unhinged like Berial.
say:8:1411431005:1.source_cn: 没什么城府，容易生气，但不像是贝利尔那种喜怒无常的癫狂……

say:9:1411431006:1.text: Actually, she acts like a normal teenager.
say:9:1411431006:1.source_cn: 就像普通小孩子一样嘛。

say:11:1411431007:1.text: In a sense, what you said is not wrong.
say:11:1411431007:1.source_cn: 某种意义上，你们讲的没有错。

say:12:1411431008:1.text: However, in another sense, you are very wrong.
say:12:1411431008:1.source_cn: 但是，某种意义上，你们又确实说得不对。

say:13:1411431009:1.text: Because there was once a Hypogean of terrible might who loved explosions and destruction.
say:13:1411431009:1.source_cn: 因为，确实曾经出现过，一个强大、凶暴，操控炸弹的恶魔。

say:14:1411431010:1.text: Let us show you the image of the Hypogean that once made the world tremble.
say:14:1411431010:1.source_cn: 让我们来为你们展示吧，曾经令世界颤抖的，强大恶魔的姿态。

narration:16:14014042:0.text: As the earthquake shakes the ground, lava splashes everywhere. You use magic to protect everyone.
narration:16:14014042:0.source_cn: 地震爆发，岩浆飞溅，你用魔法保护了众人。
narration:16:14014042:0.male: As the earthquake shakes the ground, lava splashes everywhere. You use magic to protect everyone.
narration:16:14014042:0.female: As the earthquake shakes the ground, lava splashes everywhere. You use magic to protect everyone.
